reasons_add: Al-Nashr assigns the light mīm to all readers other than the six it names for the doubled form.
Al-Nashr specifically names Abū Jaʿfar, Ibn ʿĀmir, Ḥamza, al-Kisāʾī, Khalaf, and Rawḥ as readers of the doubled mīm.
Al-Dāmghānī gives ʿidda the sense of number or count and illustrates it with months, sleepers, possessions, and people.
